jobs.command:
python3 -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os,datetime,json,hashlib,re,difflib
root=Path('/Users/robault/GitHub/sugata-avatar');leaf=root/'docs/evidence/appearance-2026-10-19/preview-lifetime-owner'
print('PID',os.getpid(),'UTC',datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat())
def pin(p):
 p=Path(p);b=p.read_bytes();return {'path':str(p),'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()}
c=json.loads((leaf/'ROOT-USAGE-CORRECTION.json').read_text());old=Path(c['original_snapshot']['path']);new=Path(c['revised']['path'])
for row in c['verified_original_inputs']+[c['original_snapshot'],c['revised']]:
 p=old if row['path']==str(new) and row['sha256']==c['original_snapshot']['sha256'] else Path(row['path'])
 actual=pin(p);assert all(actual[k]==row[k] for k in ['bytes','sha256']),row
original_receipt=json.loads((leaf/'USAGE-RECEIPT.json').read_text())
for row in original_receipt['direct_inputs']+[original_receipt['output_review']]:
 p=old if row['path']==str(new) else Path(row['path']);actual=pin(p)
 assert all(actual[k]==row[k] for k in ['bytes','sha256']),row
oldtext=old.read_text();newtext=new.read_text()
old_intro='This example is documentation, not an installed or executed client. `loadData`, `makeResource`, `attach` and their resource-removal responsibilities must be designed and qualified for that client.'
new_intro='This example is documentation, not an installed or executed client. The host creates and retains `const owner = createPreviewLifetime({ parentSignal })` before calling `preparePreview(owner, inputs)`. It keeps that same owner on success and rejection, so cleanup evidence remains accessible. `loadData`, `makeResource`, `attach` and their resource-removal responsibilities must be designed and qualified for that client.'
old_function='async function preparePreview({ loadData, makeResource, attach, parentSignal }) {'+chr(10)+'    const owner = createPreviewLifetime({ parentSignal });'
new_function='async function preparePreview(owner, { loadData, makeResource, attach }) {'
old_host='The host must retain the owner and call `close` when the preview ends.'
new_host='The host must call `close` when the preview ends. On both successful closure and preparation rejection, it must inspect the retained owner and preserve `failures` and `parentDetach` alongside any original operation error. `close` contains cleanup errors; catching the original operation error alone is insufficient. This is a host responsibility, not an implemented diagnostic callback.'
expected=oldtext
for before,after in [(old_intro,new_intro),(old_function,new_function),(old_host,new_host)]:
 assert expected.count(before)==1;expected=expected.replace(before,after,1)
assert expected==newtext
assert re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)',oldtext)==re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)',newtext)
for ref in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)',newtext):
 if '://' not in ref:assert (leaf/ref).is_file(),ref
print('COMPLETE_EXACT_DIFF')
print(''.join(difflib.unified_diff(oldtext.splitlines(keepends=True),newtext.splitlines(keepends=True),fromfile='USAGE-ORIGINAL.md',tofile='USAGE.md')),end='')
print('AUDIT_PASS','13 corrected-epoch map rows +10 original review bindings; exact three-text-change reconstruction; unchanged links; no source/proof/entry changes')
print('DIRECT_PINS',json.dumps([pin(leaf/n) for n in ['USAGE.md','USAGE-ORIGINAL.md','ROOT-USAGE-CORRECTION.json','USAGE-REVIEW.md','USAGE-RECEIPT.json','PROOF-REVIEW.md','PROOF-RECEIPT.json','PROOF-REPORT.json','PROOF-TOOL.json','PROOF-STDOUT.txt']]+[pin(root/'tools/artist-preview-lifetime.mjs'),pin(root/'tools/artist-preview-lifetime.selftest.mjs')]))
